documents.text: 80th Regiment of Light-Armed Foot The 80th Regiment of Light-Armed Foot was the first light infantry regiment in the British Army. The regiment was raised by Colonel Thomas Gage as the 80th Regiment of Light-Armed Foot in May 1758. The purpose of this unit was to provide a formal regiment that could combat France and its Native American allies during the French and Indian War, while adopting such tactics and equipment that had been proven by Roger's Rangers.
